J-43.name: Deep-linkable as-of (?asof URL serialization)
J-43.note: PARTIAL (was failing). Now working: interactive selection writes ?asof=D (persists while historical), switch-to-latest removes it, invalid/unknown ?asof degrades to latest (no crash), and a deep-linked ?asof DOES restore into the one global control (switcher + indicator + data correct). STILL FAILING: after deep-link hydration / reload / fresh tab the URL is stripped to param-free, defeating shareability. Root cause confirmed in asof-provider.tsx AsOfUrlSync: the serialize effect's deps [asOf, latest, ready, pathname] omit searchParams — the restore-path strip fires with asOf=null, then the asOf=D re-run reads a stale searchParams (current===next) and early-returns, so the strip wins permanently. Small surgical fix; re-QA reload/fresh-tab/click-through legs.
